name: Helping Those Who Hurt
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately close to those who suffer, offering comfort to the brokenhearted and strength to the weak (Psalms 34:18; Isaiah 40:29). Christ Himself experienced deep sorrow and grief, identifying with human pain and rejection (Isaiah 53:3). Believers are assured that God’s plans are for their peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11), and they are called to extend forgiveness as a reflection of God’s mercy (Matthew 6:14). Ultimately, all things work together for good to those who love God and are called according to His purpose (Romans 8:28).
